input.description: The calculation entry exactly as provided (an object is JSON-stringified).

operation.description: add, subtract, count-between, next, is-business-day or payment-due.

status.description: Whether this entry could be computed.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable outcome code, e.g. OK, INVALID_START_DATE, MISSING_END_DATE, UNPARSEABLE_PAYMENT_TERMS.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation, set when status is "error".

result.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the computed result: the new date for add/subtract/next/payment-due, or the echoed endDate for count-between.

resultHebrewDate.description: "result" as a Hebrew date, English formatting, e.g. "17 Tishrei 5787".

resultHebrewDateHe.description: "result" as a Hebrew date in gematria.

isBusinessDay.description: Set for operation "is-business-day": whether startDate is a business day under the given profile.

rolled.description: True when the computed date did not already fall on a business day and had to be rolled (payment-due only; add/subtract/next always land on a business day by construction).

rollReason.description: English name of the holiday/weekend that made rolling necessary.

businessDaysCount.description: Set for operation "count-between": positive when endDate is after startDate, negative when before, 0 when equal.

holidaysInRange.description: Holidays/extra-holidays encountered: skipped during add/subtract/next, in [startDate, endDate] for count-between, or on startDate itself for is-business-day/payment-due's final date.

halfDay.description: Whether the relevant date (startDate for is-business-day, the final date for payment-due) is a half business day (Erev-chag, or TASE's early Friday close).

halfDayReason.description: English reason for the half day.

halfDayReasonHe.description: Hebrew reason for the half day.

assumptions.description: Echoes the calendar profile and options actually used for this row.
